title: LIVE01 — Verify the existing live harness and controller telemetry hookup
description:
Original request
Earlier user asked for the actual service hookup with the earlier model and live joint telemetry.

Current evidence / status
Historical service/harness code exists, but recent comparisons were controlled standalone simulations. Live deployment readiness is not established by them.

Bounded work and acceptance criteria
Inspect service version, model checkpoint, observation/action contract, controller joint telemetry, guard logging, success/no-op behavior and failure recovery. Run one bounded end-to-end smoke test after component qualification; label replay versus live output accurately.

Dependencies and exclusions
Do not redeploy a harmful phase guard. Depends on CTRL02 and model registry.

Status semantics
Historical artifacts or implementation exist; their scope/evidence must be reconciled before claiming completion or launching replacement work.

12 October final OST sweep decision
Telemetry/guard tests pass and a current asynchronous Decisions integration smoke ran end-to-end on broad12k with full commands/RGB/joint traces. Both smoke modes failed task success; delayed-prefix eligibility rejected many commands. This is infrastructure evidence, not a qualified live harness or matched unmodifiedV4 comparison. Keep deployment gated on LIVE04 and observation reliability.

LIVE05 follow-up (12 October): 30 controlled-delay V4 episodes isolate a motion-guard regression. The known grasp survives both sampling schemes and0/0.1/2s delays without guard intervention, but disappears with unchanged enforcement, including a matched zero-wait continuous-stream comparison. LIVE06 #11026 must qualify the guard against the clipped OSC execution contract and successful expert trajectories before deployment. Current lightweight LIVE04 preview audit:30/36requests have all pairwise mean path separations within2pixels; all36show identical first/middle/last gripper commands. These are projected tool paths, not the separate privileged ghost-arm futures in#10975. Preview discriminability/critic usefulness remains unqualified; retainUNKNOWN. Already-completed preservation is not completion recognition. Evidence: branch research/live05-scheduler-isolation, experiment-history/2026-10-12-live05/REPORT.md.
